# Security policy

For vulnerabilities in Automorphic, email [munachiernesteze@gmail.com](mailto:munachiernesteze@gmail.com)
with the subject **Automorphic security report**. Include the affected commit/version,
reproduction steps, impact, and a minimal example using synthetic data.

Do not post vulnerabilities, access tokens, account data, private keys, pairing URLs, or user
conversations in public issues. Do not attach a real environment file or database.
Coordinate disclosure after the maintainer has investigated the report. There is no guaranteed
response SLA or paid bounty program. Security fixes target the current development branch;
older beta releases do not receive guaranteed backports.

Test only systems and accounts you own or have permission to test. The source license does not
authorize access to hosted Automorphic, T3, brokerage, or AI-provider infrastructure.

If a credential enters Git history, revoke or rotate it first. Removing it in a later commit
does not remove the exposure. Review all refs and release assets before publishing; see the
[source release guide](../docs/operations/open-source-release.md).
